environment.description: CLI tool deployed on EC2 instance in isolated private subnet. The metadata service endpoint is overridden via METADATA_SERVICE_URL env var to point to an internal configuration service accessible exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with a VPC endpoint policy restricting Principal to the specific task execution role. The subnet route table has NO igw/nat route entries — only local VPC CIDR (10.0.48.0/20) and the pl-63a5400a prefix list for the S3 gateway endpoint. DNS resolution for 169.254.169.254 is intercepted by a Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint rule forwarding to a local stub that returns NXDOMAIN. The interface endpoint's security group (sg-0f8e7d6c5b4a39201) restricts ingress to TCP/443 from sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 (the instance SG) only, and the endpoint policy requires aws:PrincipalOrgID condition matching o-abc123def4. Binary compiled with -fsanitize=address which terminates on use-after-free before network I/O occurs.

config.network: private subnet 10.0.48.0/20, route table: local only + pl-63a5400a (S3 GWEP), no NAT/IGW
config.endpoint_sg: sg-0f8e7d6c5b4a39201: ingress TCP/443 from sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 only
config.dns_override: Route53 Resolver rule: 169.254.169.254 -> forward to 10.0.48.2 (stub returning NXDOMAIN)
